in_hebrew.name: אלרלינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The LORD is my light, my salvation; whom shall I fear? whom shall I dread? The LORD is the light of my youth.

in_greek.name: Λουρλένη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Lurlene comes from the Old English word 'lur', which means 'light', and the Old Norse word 'rún', which means 'secret' or 'mystery'. In Greek, the name Λουρλένη (Lourlénē) translates to 'Light'.

in_latin.name: Lurlena
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Lurlene is derived from the Latin word 'lux', which means 'light'. In Latin, the name is written as Lurlena.
